description: The wakeonlan module sends magic Wake-on-LAN (WoL) broadcast packets.

parameters.name: broadcast
parameters.description: Network broadcast address to use for broadcasting magic Wake-on-LAN packet. Default: "255.255.255.255"

parameters.name: mac
parameters.description: MAC address to send Wake-on-LAN broadcast packet for.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: UDP port to use for magic Wake-on-LAN packet. Default: 7

examples:
- name: Send a magic Wake-on-LAN packet to 00:00:5E:00:53:66
  community.general.wakeonlan:
    mac: '00:00:5E:00:53:66'
    broadcast: 192.0.2.23
  delegate_to: localhost

- community.general.wakeonlan:
    mac: 00:00:5E:00:53:66
    port: 9
  delegate_to: localhost
